info.title: Incontrol Universal API
info.description: Incontrol is a quality and compliance platform for managing organizations, users, forms, drafts, documents, tasks, notifications, and cases.

get.description: Downloads a document from Incontrol in the requested file type.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: fileType
parameters.description: The type of file that should be returned.

schema.description: The type of file that should be returned.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
